title: Gold-standard annotated eval set + inter-annotator agreement
context: A held-out, double-annotated gold set is needed to evaluate extraction honestly. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. The gold set covers entity types and assertion groundedness and is released CC-BY-4.0 with provenance.
objective: Build a gold-standard annotated eval set with measured inter-annotator agreement.
acceptanceCriteria: >= 2 annotators independently annotate a held-out article sample; inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa) computed and >= 0.7; adjudication process recorded.
Gold set covers entity types + assertion groundedness; released CC-BY-4.0 with provenance.
